texts.facts: Simultaneously, the compensation granted cannot be an apology for compensation". 1. These are three connected claim petitions bearing no. MACT 615/19, 616/19 and 617/19 arising out of same road accident in which unfortunately one Ravi Kumar and Dalip Dutta expired and Seema Dutta received grievous injury, as per the case of concerned police official who has filed the present DAR. 2. In this case, 3 separate DARs are filed by the concerned police officials as per the provision of section 158 (6) MV Act ad same is treated as claim petition u/s 166 (1) MV Act, in view of provision of section 166 (4) MV Act. 3. Present case is regarding death claim of deceased Sh. Ravi Kumar. 4. Brief facts of the case are that on 28.04.2019, after receiving GD no. 2A, concerned police officials reached the spot of accident at Ring Road, AIIMS above under pass, in front of NBCC Block No.3 and found that one truck bearing no. RJ 05GB 5161 was stationed back half side on divider and from front side, such truck was over one Creta Car bearing no. DL 06TC 0436, white colour and Honda city Car grey colour bearing no. DL 7CF 9784. They further found that all the 3 vehicles were in damage condition. It was further found that such truck was coming from South Ex. Side and going towards Safdarjung Hospital side MACT No. 615/19 Sunita Vs. Yaduveer Singh @ Beera & Ors. Page No. 2 of 27 R. whereas Honda City Car and Creta car were coming from Safdarjung Hospital side to South Extension side and such truck hit the divider from its side and came to the other side of the road and hit the such two cars on the other side of the road. It was further found that in Honda City Car bearing no. DL 7CF 9784, there were three passengers; one female and two males, who were taken to hospital by the PCR. Further driver of such Creta car bearing no. DL 06PC 0436, Mr. Avinash Jindal gave a statement that he runs a cafe in Mumbai and in night between 27th and 28th April 2019, he along with his brother Saurabh Jindal and relative Sami Garg and Ankit Garg were going in such Creta Car. At about 12.00 at midnight, such offending truck from other side of the road came in very rash and negligent manner in a fast speed and by jumping the divider fell down over their car. He further stated that to their left side, there was such Honda City Car which was also hit by such truck. He further stated that as far as Creta Car occupants are concerned including himself, they have not received any physical injuries but 3 occupants of Honda City car received injuries who were taken to hospital by PCR. He further stated that driver of truck has run an away from the spot. During investigation, it was found that Dalip Datta and Sh. Ravi Kumar expired due to such Road accident and Seema Dutta received grievous injuries. 5. Accordingly, FIR in question was registered initially u/s Sunita vs . Yaduveer Singh @ Beera & Ors. on 1 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163380284/ 2 279, 337, 304 A IPC. The police after investigation in the FIR, filed charge sheet u/s 279,338,304 A IPC. Further present DAR is also filed by the concerned police officials. MACT No. 615/19 Sunita Vs. Yaduveer Singh @ Beera & Ors. Page No. 3 of 27 R. 6. As per record, driver and owner/ R-1 & 2 appeared in this case and filed their reply. In nutshell, in such reply, they stated that their vehicle was falsely implicated in the present case. It is further stated that they have not caused the accident in question. It is further stated that R-1 was holding a valid driving license at the time of accident and such vehicle was duly insured with R-3. 7. R-3/Insurance company has filed its reply. In nutshell, it is stated in such reply it is claimed that there was contributory negligence on the part of driver of such two cars but further a legal offer is also given in the present case. But as per record, same is not accepted by claimant. 8. As such, from the pleadings of parties, the following issues were framed on 22.10.2019 by my Ld. 9. PW-1/Sunita tendered her examination in chief by way of affidavit as Ex.PW1/A. She further relied upon documents Ex. PW-1/1 to Ex. PW-1/8. She was cross-examined by learned counsel for R-1 & 2 as well as by R-3. 10. Further, vide order dated 29.11.2022, it was ordered that evidence of injured/ claimant Seema Dutta in case no. 617/19 would also be read in evidence in present case. 11. Such, Seema Dutta tendered her examination in chief by way of affidavit as Ex.PW1/A. She further relied upon documents Ex. PW-1/1 to Ex. PW-1/9. Page No. 4 of 27 R. She was cross-examined by learned counsel for R-1 & 2 as well as by R-3. 12. No other evidence was led on behalf of claimants, thereafter, PE was closed. 13. No evidence is led by respondent side despite opportunity given. In the present case, police after investigation had filed charge-sheet against respondent no.1 under section 279,338,304A of IPC which is also suggestive of negligence of respondent in causing the accident. The IO has filed Detailed Accident Report before this Tribunal.
